_readme.purpose: ChatGPT image-generation prompts for the 6-15 Aug 2026 blog batch, rewritten to match the existing Digitally Next design system as produced by the in-house designer.
_readme.how_to_use: Paste ONE images[n] object into ChatGPT with: 'Generate this image exactly to this specification.' Generate one at a time. Batching makes the model blend briefs together.
_readme.canonical: This file is the source of truth. scripts/push-dn-blogs-aug-2026.mjs carries a short prose version of each for reference only.

design_system_observed.source: Derived from five existing DN images: the Netflix iceberg case study, the customer-journey path render, the marketing-machine render, the review/word-of-mouth speech-bubble render, and the Shopify case study photo.

two_formats.case_study: Photographic or photorealistic base image, company logo top-left beside the words 'Case Study', the 'X | WORKPLACE DNA' lockup bottom-left, and short overlaid annotation lines with small teal or red marker dots and thin leader lines. Used for the Workplace DNA series. NOT used for any of the ten posts below.
two_formats.concept_illustration: Soft 3D rendered conceptual scene, no headline text, teal and red accents together, tactile rounded forms, gentle depth of field. This is the format for all ten posts below.

design_system_observed.medium: Soft 3D render, claymorphism-adjacent: rounded tactile forms, matte-to-satin surfaces, gentle contact shadows, shallow depth of field with the background falling softly out of focus. Small floating badges and pins carry simple flat line icons.
design_system_observed.camera: Slight three-quarter or gentle isometric view, never flat-on. Objects sit on a subtly textured ground plane with soft contour or topographic detail.

palette.light_background: warm off-white #F5F2EE falling to cool grey #E3E5E8, with a soft warm light source top-left
palette.dark_background: deep navy-black #0B1219 falling to #131C26, lit only by the emissive objects

design_system_observed.colour_rule: Mint and coral red appear TOGETHER in every image. Mint carries the system, the flow, the working state. Red marks the single point of emphasis: the endpoint, the alert, the thing the reader should notice. Red is always the minority colour, roughly one part red to five parts mint.
design_system_observed.icons: Simple flat line icons inside rounded pins or circular badges are part of the language and are encouraged, but they must never form words or letters.

technical_notes.resolution: Generate at 1920x1080 minimum. The blog hero renders at 1920 wide, so a 600px-wide image upscales badly and looks soft.
technical_notes.crop_warning: The hero container is full-width at 520px tall using object-cover with object-top, so on desktop only roughly the TOP HALF of a 16:9 image survives. On mobile (~390x320) the sides are clipped and roughly the middle 68% of width shows. Keep the subject in the UPPER-CENTRE and leave the bottom third as quiet ground plane or background.
technical_notes.hotspot: After uploading to Sanity, set the image hotspot on the main subject. The 600x340 card crop uses it, and without it the card crops from the middle and can pick up empty ground.

images.scene: A row of six identical rounded 3D machine modules sitting on a low light-grey plinth, viewed from a gentle three-quarter angle. The first module on the left is powered on: its housing glows soft mint from within, a thin mint light-trail runs out of it along the plinth, and a small rounded badge floats just above it carrying a simple flat spark icon. images.core_idea: A journey path that loops back to a marker it already passed, without noticing.
images.scene: A smooth 3D ribbon pathway laid out on a softly contoured ground plane, curving in a wide flattened loop that clearly returns to where it began. Rounded map pins stand along the path at even intervals. The pins on the most recent stretch are bright mint with crisp flat line icons and a glowing light trail running beneath them along the ribbon. Moving around the loop, the pins fade progressively to dull pale grey, their icons barely visible, several tipped slightly as if forgotten. At the point where the path rejoins itself, a single coral red pin stands where a faded grey pin already sits, the two occupying almost the same spot.

images.core_idea: One strong flow entering a splitter, seven weak trickles leaving it.
images.scene: A 3D machine assembly on a low dark plinth, seen from a gentle three-quarter angle. One thick rounded pipe enters from the left carrying a strong, bright mint flow, visible as a glowing channel of light inside translucent tubing. The pipe meets a compact splitter block in the centre, from which seven much thinner pipes fan out to the right, each carrying a visibly weaker, dimmer mint trickle, the outermost two barely lit at all. A small coral red warning indicator glows on the splitter block housing, and a short coral red bar sits low beside the output side, clearly shorter than the input flow. Small rounded gauge badges float above the assembly carrying simple flat line icons.

composition.subject_placement: Centre the speech bubble in the UPPER-CENTRE, its centre at roughly 38% of frame height, drawn wide so the four badges sit comfortably in one row
composition.safe_area: Keep the whole bubble including its tail, and all four badges, inside the top 60% of the frame and the central 70% of the width. Leave the bottom third to the storefront and dark surface.
composition.negative_space: Dark open space surrounding the bubble

palette.background: Deep navy-black #0B1219 falling to #131C26, lit only by the emissive elements
palette.primary_accent: #6FD8CA mint for the bubble outline, three of the badges and the network threads
palette.secondary_accent: #E8434E coral red for the payment badge only
palette.ratio: Mint dominant, one red badge as the point of emphasis

images.lighting: The bubble outline and badges are the light sources, with soft bloom and gentle reflection on the dark base. Warm light spills from the storefront windows.
images.mood: Warm and human. A conversation, not a transaction terminal.
must_include: Exactly four badges in a single row inside the bubble
A visible bubble tail so the shape reads as conversation
Exactly one badge in coral red, the rest mint
Icons simple enough to stay distinct at thumbnail size
must_avoid: Any text, letters, numbers, timestamps, or message previews
The colour green anywhere in the image
The WhatsApp logo, phone-handset icon, or any recognisable messaging-app branding
Chat interface elements: message threads, read receipts, double tick marks, avatars, input bars
Phone or device mockups
Faces, people, or hands
Cyberpunk or neon aesthetics

images.core_idea: The lights have come on away from the few big centres.
images.scene: A softly contoured 3D ground plane with gentle topographic lines, seen from a gentle isometric angle. Near the centre stand four large rounded map pins, tall but dull matte grey, unlit, their icons dark. Spread widely across the surrounding ground are around twenty smaller rounded pins, brightly lit in mint with crisp flat line icons, several of them capped in coral red, each casting a soft glow and a small contact shadow onto the ground. A few slim mint light-trails run outward from the centre toward the smaller pins, thinning as they go. The visual weight sits clearly away from the middle.

style.medium: Soft 3D render, claymorphism-adjacent, rounded tactile pin forms with satin surfaces
style.camera: Gentle isometric three-quarter view looking down on the ground plane
style.depth_of_field: Shallow, the far pins softly defocused
style.surface: Matte ground with soft contour relief, glossy-capped rounded pins

composition.subject_placement: Centre the whole pin field in the UPPER-CENTRE of the frame, its centre at roughly 40% of frame height, spread wide and shallow
composition.safe_area: Keep the four large centre pins and the great majority of the small bright pins inside the top 60% of the frame and the central 70% of the width. Leave the bottom third as quiet contoured ground.
composition.negative_space: Open contoured ground between pin groups

palette.background: Warm off-white #F5F2EE falling to cool grey #E3E5E8, soft light from the upper left
palette.primary_accent: #6FD8CA mint for the small lit pins and the outward trails, glowing #A8EDE2
palette.secondary_accent: #E8434E coral red capping several of the small pins
neutrals: #8A9198 the four large unlit centre pins
palette.ratio: Mint dominant across the periphery, red on a handful of small pins, the large centre pins fully neutral

images.lighting: Soft diffused studio light from the upper left, gentle contact shadows under every pin, the small lit pins casting their own faint glow onto the ground
images.mood: Optimistic discovery. The map has more life in it than expected.
must_include: A clear size inversion: the large pins are dull, the small pins are bright
Visibly more pins outside the centre cluster than inside it
Irregular organic scatter rather than a regular grid
Several small pins capped in coral red
must_avoid: Any text, letters, numbers, city names, or labels
A recognisable outline of India or any country, coastline, or national border
Real map features: roads, rivers, state boundaries, latitude grids
Flags or national symbols of any kind
Faces, people, or hands
Brand logos
Pure black backgrounds or neon
